title: All 121 Haircuts - Expedition 33 Hairstyle Locations Guide
description: Complete haircut guide for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. All 121 hairstyles with locations, including Lune's 18 styles, Gustave's cuts, and how to unlock them all.

sections.title: Haircuts Overview
sections.content:
Lune - 18 hairstyle options

Expedition 33 has 121 unlockable hairstyles across all characters. Haircuts are obtained from merchants, boss drops, NPC questlines, and exploration finds. About half are sold by merchants, the rest are found in the world.

How to Change Haircuts

  • Visit any stylist NPC in towns/hubs
  • Access the customization menu once haircuts are unlocked
  • Haircuts are purely cosmetic — no gameplay effect
  • Visible in all cutscenes

sections.title: Gustave — All Hairstyles
sections.content:
Gustave has approximately 8-10 hairstyles available:

  • Default
  • Short Cropped — Merchant
  • Slicked Back — Quest reward
  • Messy — Exploration find
  • Military — Merchant
  • Long — Late-game unlock
  • + Additional DLC/patch styles

sections.title: Tips for Collecting All Haircuts
sections.content:
• Check merchants after every major story beat — New stock appears regularly
  • Some haircuts are missable — If you progress past certain areas, you may lose access to specific merchants
  • Boss drops are rare — You may need to retry specific fights for haircut drops
  • DLC/Patch content — Update to the latest version for anniversary and seasonal haircuts
  • 121 total requires multiple playthroughs — Some are locked behind specific Chosen Path routes
